name: Arduino Nano 33 BLE (nRF52840)

circuitpython.note: CircuitPython is installed with Arduino's bossac (double-tap reset → the Arduino bootloader), not from this page: see the CircuitPython board page. After that, deploy from the page as for any board.

flash.bootloader_instructions: Double-tap the reset button: the Arduino bootloader (SAM-BA over USB) appears; flash the CircuitPython .bin with bossac from a terminal — this page cannot (no esptool, no UF2). Rev2 and the original board use the same build.
flash.note: The one board here this page does not flash itself.

battery.divider_note: no battery circuit; 5 V USB or VIN

notes: BLE only: the ble-beacon template. No Wi-Fi.
Flashing CircuitPython needs bossac from a terminal (Arduino's bootloader); everything after that is from the page.
